$comment: R1 — files explicitly allowed to use the live repo's .claims/ dir or invoke git outside the safeGit helper. See ADR-0015 (test-isolation-enforcement) and ADR-0052 (R1.3 claims-dir-leak). Each entry must be paired with a per-file annotation: `// @test-isolation: live-repo-allowed | reason: <text >= 60 chars>`. Growth from the initial list requires a CHANGELOG entry referencing the addition reason.
